note: Context7 library ids for each lab's documentation, as Context7 listed them on the day read. Context7 is a third party's index of snippets taken from the labs' pages and repositories: it answers a question with ranked snippets, each naming its source. It is a way to look something up from a session that has the Context7 connector. It is not the record: nothing in the catalogue, the check or the reference reads it, and it cannot hand over a library whole (see docs/model-updates.md).
